rationale: The current Transformers.js release pins onnxruntime-node 1.24.3 and requests sharp ^0.34.5, so no supported direct upgrade clears both advisories.
Forcing onnxruntime-node or sharp outside the upstream dependency constraints could change native runtime or model behavior without an embeddings rebuild and artifact-parity review.
npm audit --omit=dev reported no production findings when this exception was accepted.
controls: Keep the package dynamically imported only by data/lib/embeddings-builder.js.
Do not add npm overrides for this chain without a successful embeddings build, artifact-parity review, and full test suite.
Re-review this exception by the review_by date or when Transformers.js publishes a release with patched transitive versions, whichever comes first.
retire_when: Every locked adm-zip version in the Transformers.js graph is at least 0.6.0.
Every locked sharp version in the Transformers.js graph is at least 0.35.0.
The embeddings builder succeeds and generated artifacts are unchanged or their changes are reviewed and explained.
The full test suite and npm audit complete without high or critical findings.
